unexercisedLimits: Headless audio output could not actually be heard; enabled/running/suspended context and cue oscillator creation were observed instead.
375x400 tests constrained writing space, not a physical mobile software keyboard or IME. 200% text was root-font enlargement, not a device accessibility-setting test.
Print media and a real browser-generated PDF were checked; native OS print/share dialogs, paper output and image-download delivery were not verified.
The QR image renders and is explicitly an offline message; it was not scanned on a physical phone.
Every inventory default was navigated; every combinatorial inventory state/browser/assistive-technology combination was not exercised.

Shared browser control stalls initially caused one harness-enforced JS VM reset. Main supplied a dedicated CDP process; native pointer/keyboard completed remaining proof. Differently named CDP handles adopted the same page, so later work used one handle.
